content: पर्जन्यः .²1 A rain cloud, thundering cloud, a cloud in general; प्रवृद्ध इव पर्जन्यः सारङ्गैरभिनन्दितः <ls>R. 17. 15</ls>; <ls>Mk. 10. 60</ls>. .²2 Rain; अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसंभवः <ls>Bg. 3. 14</ls>. .²3 The god of rain; <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 4. 11</ls>. .²4 The muttering or roaring of clouds. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Indra, Sūrya, Viṣṇu and some other deities; <ls>Bhāg. 10. 20. 5</ls> (here पर्जन्य means the sun).
